items.title: Sun Lamp Decaf
items.desc:
“I might as well be drinking tea*,” you say to no one in particular as you drink another cup of lousy decaffeinated coffee. Don’t feel defeated by bad decaf. Turn to Tandem’s brighter, sweeter Sun Lamp. With hints of marshmallow, graham cracker and green grape, let the surprising flavors of Sun Lamp reimagine what decaffeinated coffee can be and leave the anxiety behind.
*No offense to tea. We love tea.

items.title: West End Blues
items.desc: Traditional in name only, West End Blues is a complex blend of flavors and textures. Fruity but not fruit-forward, grounded in chocolate and sparkling with zesty notes of baking spices and tea, WEB shines when combined with milk but stands on its own as a killer drip coffee.

items.title: Stoker
items.desc: Sometimes you want a delicious, no-nonsense cup of coffee, beloved by metalheads and hardcore grandmothers alike. That’s why Tandem shed its “Light Roaster” mantle to create our version of a “Kinda Dark” roasted coffee. Inspired by late-night diner runs, hot donuts, and arctic blasts, Stoker’s pleasantly sweet roastiness will carry you through the day.

items.title: Time & Temperature
items.desc: Effervescent, electric, and just plain cool, Time and Temperature is Tandem’s signature espresso blend. Perfect for dancing alone or with friends, it doubles as a delightful drip coffee. However you enjoy its crisp acidity and punchy sweetness, it’s our embodiment of “Spreading Joy” in every cup.

items.title: LOS CASERIOS
items.desc:
From the highlands of Cajamarca, Peru, Los Caserios brings together the work of 14 smallholder producers from the regions of Jaén and San Ignacio. Grown at elevations between 1,650 and 1,900 metres, this Washed coffee combines several traditional varieties to create a sweet and balanced cup.
Carefully selected for its quality and flavour, Los Caserios offers a combination of citrus freshness and gentle sweetness. Expect notes of pomelo, brown sugar and vanilla, complemented by a silky mouthfeel and a black tea character.

Sky Project-Pearl
商品について｜ 標高2,450m の土地が育む豊かな甘さ。真珠のように繊細で、美しいウォッシュドコーヒー。
味わい｜ 洋梨やマスカットのようなみずみずしい果実感に、はちみつのような甘さ。つるんと滑らかな口当たりと、長く続く上品な余韻が魅力的。
淹れ方｜
Philocoffeaにご来店いただき、ありがとうございます。お待たせしました！今年もエチオピア "Sky Project"のコーヒーが届きました！

Sky Projectは、Tri-Up Coffeeが地球温暖化による気候変動を見据え、より標高の高い土地でのコーヒー生産の可能性を探るプロジェクト。長年築いてきた生産者との関係をもとに、栽培や精製の技術を共有しながら、持続的なコーヒーづくりに取り組んでいます。

Fincas Putushio
商品について｜ Pepeさんと息子ホセが手がける新プロジェクト、エクアドル・Fincas Putushioの浅煎りコーヒー。
味わい｜ 白い花を思わせる香りに、ミカンや青リンゴのようなジューシーな果実感。蜂蜜のような優しい甘さと、綺麗な余韻が続きます。

Philocoffeaにご来店いただき、ありがとうございます。

ケニアのコーヒーのご紹介です。
ケニア中央部、ケニア山の南麓に広がるキリニャガ地域は、世界的にも高品質なコーヒーの産地として知られています。標高は1,600mから1,800m。ケニア山の火山活動によって生まれた肥沃な火山灰土壌は、コーヒー栽培に理想的な環境をつくり出しています。この土地で育つコーヒーは、生き生きとした酸味だけでなく、なめらかで厚みのある質感を併せ持つことが特徴です。
今回ご紹介するロットは、このキリニャガ地域にあるキウニュ水洗工場で精製されたコーヒーです。キウニュ水洗工場は1960年代から続く歴史ある水洗工場で、現在はカリサシ農協に所属しています。周辺に暮らす約3,000名の小規模生産者が収穫したチェリーを持ち寄り、一つひとつ丁寧に精製が行われています。

items.title: 025 Mexico Chiapas Decaf 有機JAS
items.desc:
カフェインレスということに気付かないないほどの美味しさ
025 Mexico Chiapas Decaf 有機JAS
PHILOCOFFEAにご来店ありがとうございます。
定番のカフェインレスコーヒーのご紹介です。
美味しいコーヒーが飲みたいけどカフェインが気になるという方多いですよね。
でもカフェインレスのコーヒーってなんだか薬品くさいというか人工的な香りがするので敬遠している方というのも多いのではないでしょうか？
私もその一人でした。
カフェインレスのコーヒーが美味しくなかった理由、それはカフェインの除去の方法によるものです。
特殊な薬剤を使ってカフェインを除去しており、カフェイン以外の成分も損なわれてしまいます。
そのため、通常のコーヒーに比べて風味が劣っていました。
そこで、弊社が使用するのは、
Descamex社のマウンテンウォーター製法でカフェインを除去したもの。
この製法は、多くの有機認証を取得しており、化学的な溶媒を一切使用せずに安全にカフェイン除去をおこなうシステムです。
有機認証を受けた原料の生産履歴を透明化したまま最終製品にまで仕上げることが可能で、世界でも数少ない有機デカフェ工場になっております。
今回はメキシコ　チアパス州の「 Product Conservacion El Triunfo」の79農園が生産したコーヒーをデカフェに仕上げました。

items.title: La Nueva Montaña
items.desc:
Antonio and Aracely’s coffees are processed with incredible care and attention. All happens in the mill, located lower on the mountain, meaning more sun and warmer days, perfect for drying naturals. Once the Cherry is picked, it is rested in sealed bags in the shade to begin fermentation. The morning after, the cherry is soaked and cleaned, the soaking helps to homogenise the temperature and lower the microbial count. They are then dried for a minimum of 20 days. The result is a complex, flavourful and bold coffee, packed full of florals, berries and tropical notes.

The actual lot is a culmination of several smallholders in the local region who grow their cherry on their land before picking and drying with the whole fruit intact. The warm days and cooler nights allow for slow drying of the fruit, that allows for more sugars and tropical notes to develop into the final cup profile. En smakfull koffeinfri kaffe som ikke går på bekostning av smaken. La Serranía Decaf er beviset på at du kan nyte en kompleks og fruktig kopp spesialkaffe, helt uten koffein. Dette er kaffen for deg som elsker smaken av god kaffe sent på kvelden, eller for deg som ønsker å redusere koffeininntaket uten å miste kaffeopplevelsen.
Ikke din vanlige decaf
Glem alt du vet om kjedelig koffeinfri kaffe. La Serranía byr på en overraskende og delikat smaksprofil. Kaffen har en myk syrlighet og en lang, behagelig ettersmak.
Naturlig prosessert med sukkerrør
Hvordan fjerner man 99,7% av koffeinet og samti

items.title: Kaffebønner Brasil Fazenda IP
items.desc:
I 1967 etablerte Isidro Pereira kaffegården Fazenda IP. Etter å ha fullført landbruks- og gårdsstudier ble også sønnen Luiz Paulo Pereira Sr. med på laget. I 1974 ble gården utvidet, flere og flere kaffeplanter ble plantet, mens jordbruksarealet vokste over 500% – og far og sønn ble pionerer innen kaffedyrking i Carmo de Minas i Brasil.
Rundt byen Carmo de Minas, ligger flere av de beste kaffegårdene i Brasil. Høyde over havet, næringsrikt jordsmonn og nøyaktig foredling av kaffebærene, har gjort at bønder i dette området de senere år har blitt belønnet med mange priser for sin gode kaffe. Det

items.title: Kaffebønner Oslo Mellombrent
items.desc:
Oslo Mellombrent er en kaffeblanding laget for dem som liker en søt og fyldig kaffe.
Vårt team har selektert ulike kaffepartier og brent blandingen for å fremheve sødme og få en balansert kopp med bløt munnfølelse.
Innholdet i blandingen vil variere etter sesong, men smaken vil være mot melkesjokolade og tørket frukt.
Oslo Mellombrent passer til automatiske maskiner og filterkaffe.
Innholder 2 x 250g Oslo Mellombrent

items.title: Kaffebønner Oslo Mørkbrent
items.desc:
Oslo Mørkbrent er en kaffeblanding laget for dem som liker en kraftig og fyldig kopp kaffe eller espresso. Vårt team har selektert ulike kaffepartier og brent blandingen for å fremheve sødme og få en rik munnfølelse.
Innholdet i blandingen vil variere etter sesong, men smaken vil alltid være mot nougat, tørket frukt og kakao.
Oslo Mørkbrent passer både til espresso og kaffemaskiner, samt for de av oss som liker litt krutt i trakteren.
Innholder 2 x 250g Oslo Mørkbrent

items.title: Kaffebønner Østmarka
items.desc:
Østmarka er vår sesongbaserte espressoblanding. Espressoblandingen består av spesielt utvalgte kaffepartier valgt for sine attributter for å få en ren, søt og balansert espresso.
Innholdet i blandingen vil variere etter sesong, men vårt mål er at dette skal være en fruktig espresso-blanding med god balanse og fin sødme. Du vil ofte finne kaffe fra både Amerika og Afrika i denne blandingen, men partiene vil variere fra sesong til sesong.
Innholder 2 x 250g Østmarka espresso

items.title: XMAS COFFEE FINCA MAJAHUAL - ESPRESSO/ DARKER
items.desc:
The perfect finishing touch to your Christmas table, or a gift for a friend: a full-bodied Christmas coffee from Finca Majahual in El Salvador. 🎄
This natural-processed Red Bourbon from the Finca Majahual farm is our richer Christmas coffee option, and a perfect companion to the Christmas dessert table.
The coffee has the juicy, full body typical of natural processing. In the cup you can taste the soft sweetness and fruitiness of Christmas, with notes of dark cherry and brown sugar. It works especially well as espresso or filter coffee for anyone who enjoys a slightly fuller-bodied, medium-dar

items.title: XMAS COFFEE LA CORDILLERA - FILTER COFFEE
items.desc:
A fruity treat for Christmas morning or a gift for a friend: La Cordillera Christmas coffee from Nicaragua 🎄
This year’s lighter Christmas coffee comes from northern Nicaragua. In this bright, washed coffee you can taste the sweetness of pear, marzipan and the roundness of milk chocolate. It’s the kind of coffee you’ll want to brew by the potful for the Christmas table and serve with gingerbread cookies or Christmas pastries.
For those who prefer a fuller-bodied coffee, we also recommend our Finca Majahual Christmas coffee or the Christmas Coffee Duo featuring two coffees.

items.title: SURPLUS COFFEES
items.desc:
What makes it a surplus coffee?
We want to make sure that every bag of coffee we’ve roasted and packed with love gets enjoyed, so from time to time we put bags left over from mix-ups or surplus on sale at a small discount.
Test roast: Our coffee selection changes often, so we roast test batches regularly while we look for the best possible roast profile for each coffee. These are excellent test roasts of new coffees whose profiles we may still fine-tune, or for which we haven’t yet finalised detailed tasting notes and other details.
Surplus coffee: Sometimes a week’s roast leaves us with more

items.title: CASA VIEJA, GUATEMALA - FILTER COFFEE
items.desc:
This coffee from Ismael Quinteros Orantes’s small Casa Vieja farm in Santa Rosa, Guatemala, offers notes of nectarine, marmalade and milk chocolate.
On the slopes of El Volcancito, at 1,760 metres above sea level, Ismael grows coffee on just over two hectares. He is the third generation of coffee farmers in his family. Around 60 years ago, his grandfather grew both sugarcane and coffee and found that coffee was the more profitable crop. items.title: DON ELI, COSTA RICA - FILTER COFFEE
items.desc:
This washed Don Eli from the mountains of Tarrazú offers notes of s weet grape, mandarin and fudge-like sweetness. The mouthfeel is juicy and smooth.
The coffee comes from the Montero family, who helped build Tarrazú’s specialty coffee scene and guide the region’s shift from traditional coffee farming toward quality-focused micro mills and direct trade. Carlos Montero founded the Don Eli micro mill in 2014 and named it after his father, Eli. Today, processing is led by Carlos’s son, Jacob Montero, who keeps refining his methods so that the character of each harvest can shine through.

items.desc:
This is the third coffee of the season from the Ureña family’s Café Rivense farm. This time it’s a naturally processed Casiopea. Its full, smooth body is complemented by notes of blueberry, plum wine and pecan.
Unlike the farm’s two previous coffees ( La Catarata Honey and La Catarata Anaerobic Natural ), this one comes from a plot called El Renacer. The plot sits at 1,700 metres and is planted with Casiopea. This relatively rare variety is an Arabica F1 hybrid, a cross between Caturra and a wild Ethiopian strain. items.title: TIMANCO, COLOMBIA - ESPRESSO / DARKER
items.desc:
Here’s that crowd-pleasing, reliable everyday espresso. This washed Colombian coffee also works beautifully as a darker-roasted filter coffee. Expect notes of ripe, full-bodied plum and red apple, with a brown sugar sweetness in the finish.
Timaná is one of Colombia’s oldest indigenous settlements. The region is known for its unique geography and waterways: it’s surrounded not only by the Andes but also by the Magdalena and Golden rivers. This combination of geographical factors gives the area’s coffees their balanced, layered character.

items.title: LA GUACA, BOURBON AJI, COLOMBIA - FILTER COFFEE
items.desc:
This coffee, made from the (still) rare Bourbon Ají variety, comes from José Herman Salazar and his family farm, Finca La Guaca, in the Pitalito area of southern Huila, Colombia. It is a carefully grown and precisely processed coffee from a family business with a long-term focus on improving quality. The cup is clean and nuanced, with notes of apple pie and star fruit and the sweetness of panela.

items.title: LA CATARATA ANAEROBIC NATURAL, COSTA RICA
items.desc:
An anaerobically fermented, natural processed Red Catuai coffee from the Ureña family, at Café Rivense's La Catarata farm in Costa Rica. A full-bodied and sweet coffee, with the anaerobic fermentation adding a distinctly layered character to the cup. Expect notes of fruit jam, cacao nibs and caramel, with a velvety mouthfeel and restrained acidity. This coffee pairs exceptionally well with milk.

items.title: BOMBE ANAEROBIC NATURAL, ETHIOPIA - FILTER COFFEE
items.desc:
Coffees like this don't show up in the GLC lineup all the time, but right now, one does. A special lot, anaerobically fermented and naturally processed from Ethiopia. Light fermentation combined with the balance and sweetness that natural processing brings makes this one a real treat. Expect notes of papaya, bergamot and dark chocolate.

items.title: LA CATARATA HONEY, COSTA RICA - FILTER COFFEE
items.desc:
We're delighted to bring this Costa Rican coffee back into our lineup again this year. This coffee from the Ureña family's Café Rivense farm bursts with sweet juiciness! In the flavor you'll find the fruitiness like plum and juiciness of ripe black cherry along with the after taste of cocoa nibs, with a mild acidity that's well balanced with the mouthfeel.
This coffee comes from Café Rivense del Chirripó, a family-owned smallholder farm founded in 2005 by Régulo Ureña and Isabel Rojas in southern Costa Rica. The farm's quality work has been recognized in competitions such as the Cup of Excelle

items.desc: Our Christmas release is this Yellow Catuai from a Cup of Excellence-winning producer, with notes of sherry and candied orange.

items.title: URDD Java Natural
items.desc: Java, crafted using the process that led Luis Alberto to win the 2020 Cup of Excellence. Elegant and delicate, with notes of watermelon, melon, and hazelnut.

items.title: Shemzu Abajiru Natural
items.desc: JARC varieties grown by Shemzu Abajiru, a small producer from Jimma. Notes of plum, pear and toffee.

items.title: Farid Keno Natural
items.desc: First year working with Farid Keno from Jimma, with this lot of JARC varieties. A coffee with notes of strawberry, pineapple, and caramel.

items.title: Elmer Pérez Geisha
items.desc: Delicate Geisha variety with a washed process that stands out for its complexity and notes of jasmine, bergamot and white grape.

items.title: Santa Rosa Honey
items.desc: An exceptionally clean Pacamara produced by Raúl Rivera, a four-time Cup of Excellence champion. Notes of blackberry, apricot, and honey.

items.title: El Pacaya Decaf
items.desc: Bourbon, Catuaí, and Caturra varieties resulting a dense, creamy body with notes of yellow fruits and cocoa.

items.title: Kasahun Jabo Natural Filtro
items.desc: Bomb! This natural process from Kasahun with traditional Ethiopian varieties has notes of strawberry, lavender blossom, and cacao.

items.title: Esperanza Natural Mystic
items.desc: Caturra from Luis A. Balladarez, multiple-time Cup of Excellence winner, processed with our ‘Natural Mystic’ recipe. Notes of melon, white chocolate and hazelnut.

items.title: Nesru Aba Nura
items.desc: This producer exceeds expectations with an extremely clean traditional natural—variety 74110—with notes of blackberry, violet, and spices.

items.title: Andrés Torres Geisha Natural
items.desc: This Geisha variety is an ode to its origin and natural process, with notes of white flowers, lychee, and subtle hints of raspberry.

items.title: Volcancitos Honey
items.desc: We strengthen our relationship with Sergio with this Honey-processed Red Catuai. Luscious, with notes of pineapple in syrup, blood orange, and honey.

items.title: Simona: Abasambi Natural
items.desc: New relationship with this Jimma grower who cultivates varieties 74110 and Melo. Notes of blackberry, plum, chocolate, and toasted almonds.

items.title: Volcancitos
items.desc: Sergio Gutiérrez grows this Catuaí in the Mozonte region. This washed process is juicy and clean, with notes of stone fruits.

items.title: Alessi Moka
items.desc: Invented in the early 1930s, the Moka pot (also known as the Italian coffee maker) revolutionized the way we prepare coffee at home. In 2019, architect David Chipperfield redesigned this iconic coffee maker, which we love thanks to the details of its cast aluminum model.

items.title: Winter Coffee Blend
items.desc: A special meeting of two coffees from Guatemala and Costa Rica, capturing all the magic of the holidays. The spicy notes of gingerbread, the bright acidity of cranberry, and the delicate sweetness of vanilla create a warm, harmonious blend, perfect for enjoying the most special moments of Christmas. To give as a gift, share, or simply savor.

items.title: Ethiopia • Tome • Natural
items.desc:
From the highlands of the Guji region in Ethiopia, at an altitude of 1,900 to 2,200 meters, comes a coffee that expresses the full elegance and aromatic complexity of this extraordinary region. Grown on the Oboleyan farm, this Heirloom variety Single Origin coffee is processed using the Natural process, which brings out its sweetness and delicate aromatic notes.
In the cup, the elegant floral notes of jasmine are intertwined with the lively freshness of lemongrass , leaving room for the soft, enveloping sweetness of honey. The result is a harmonious, refined coffee with balanced acidity, a ple

items.title: Ethiopia Worka Wuri
items.desc:
In the heart of Gedeb, one of the most renowned areas of the Yirgacheffe region, this single-origin coffee is grown at an altitude of 1,900 to 2,100 meters. Here, the cool climate, wide temperature swings, and fertile soils allow the cherries to ripen slowly, developing extraordinary aromatic complexity.
The Heirloom varieties, ancient indigenous Ethiopian cultivars, give this coffee an elegant, nuanced profile that expresses the full character of its terroir. The washed process enhances its clarity and brightness, highlighting the transparency of its aromatic notes and the pleasant liveliness

items.title: Ethiopia Aricha Wubanchi
items.desc:
A single-origin coffee from Aricha Wubanchi, in the heart of the Yirgacheffe region, grown at an altitude of 2,200 meters.
Made from Heirloom varieties and processed using the washed method, this coffee showcases the finesse of Ethiopia’s high altitudes. A bright, clean cup where lively acidity intertwines with delicate sweetness.
Notes of peach, lime, and berries come through on the palate, with an elegant, fresh, and lingering aromatic profile.

items.title: Honduras Finca El Puente • Anaerobic Natural
items.desc:
We’re talking about the same botanical variety, Catuai, and the same processing method. The only difference is the fermentation method: this time, it’s 100% anaerobic fermentation, meaning entirely without oxygen.
This coffee offers a rounder, more complex acidity, with fruity notes reminiscent of pineapple. Its sweetness is intense and recalls dried fruit, like raisins, with a rich body and a lingering, sweet, syrupy aftertaste, enriched with hints of honey.

items.title: Honduras Finca El Puente • Marsellesa • washed
items.desc:
Finca El Puente Marsellesa Washed comes from Marcala, Honduras, at an altitude of 1,550 meters. The Marsellesa variety is processed using the Washed method, which helps enhance its clarity and aromatic definition.
In the cup, it has a sweet, fresh, and fruity profile: citrus notes of orange meet the sweetness of red apple and cane sugar, creating a pleasant, harmonious balance.
A coffee with a lively, well-defined character, where freshness and sweetness come together in a clean, balanced, enjoyable cup.

items.title: Honduras Finca El Puente • Anacafe • washed
items.desc:
From Honduras, in the Marcala region, comes a coffee grown at Finca El Puente, at an altitude of 1,550 meters. The Anacafe variety, processed using the Washed method, produces a clean, sweet cup where hints of honey meet the smoothness of maple syrup and the rich notes of caramel.
A profile built around sweetness, with full, harmonious flavors unfolding in the cup and leading to a pleasantly lingering finish.

items.title: Honduras Finca El Puente • Geisha • Washed
items.desc:
Finca El Puente "Geisha Washed" is a single-origin coffee grown using the prized Geisha variety and processed using the washed method. This precise and meticulous process brings out the coffee's clarity and aromatic definition.
Its sensory notes reveal a floral, fresh, and fruity profile. The delicate mango meets the vibrant freshness of lime and the juicy sweetness of pineapple, creating an elegant, balanced cup full of nuance.
Considered one of the most exclusive coffees in our selection, it stands out for its aromatic complexity and elegance in the cup. A Geisha that reveals, sip after sip,

items.title: Uganda • Bantu Blossom
items.desc:
From Uganda comes a coffee that tells the story of a region still waiting to be explored. Grown at an altitude of 1,600 to 1,800 meters by Agri Evolve, it brings together the SL14 and SL28 varieties, both deeply rooted in the history of coffee cultivation in this part of Africa.
The natural process brings out its sweeter, fruitier character, creating a rich cup full of nuances. Blueberry stands out with its juicy note, followed by the mellow sweetness of chestnut and a deeper finish of dark chocolate.
A profile that balances fruit, sweetness, and intensity, revealing a side of Uganda worth dis

items.title: Colombia • Los Nogales • Bourbon
items.desc:
Grown at an altitude of 1,750 meters at Finca Nogales, this harvest showcases the exceptional qualities of the Bourbon Pimienta variety, processed using the meticulous “Dark Room Dried” natural method, designed to preserve its full aromatic complexity.
At the first sip, rich, creamy notes of apricot yogurt emerge, blending gently with hints of banana before giving way to a delicate violet finish. A vibrant, enveloping, unforgettable cup that turns every sip into a moment to savor.

items.title: Panama Finca Lerida • pacamara
items.desc: From the highlands of Alto Quiel, Panama , at 1,700 meters, comes the Pacamara from Finca Lérida . Processed using the natural method, it offers a rich, fruity profile in the cup, where the sweetness of honey meets the juicy notes of plum and the aromatic brightness of orange peel . A coffee with a bold character that tells the full story of its origin.

items.title: Panama Finca Lerida • natural
items.desc: In the highlands of Alto Quiel, Panama , at 1,700 meters, Finca Lerida is home to a Geisha that tells the story of its land with every sip. Processed using the natural method, it reveals an intense, nuanced aromatic profile: the floral fragrance of jasmine opens the tasting, making way for the tropical sweetness of mango and the juicy brightness of blueberry . A medley of aromas that makes this cup complex and surprising, and a highlight of Best of Panama 2026.

items.title: Panama Finca Lerida • washed
items.desc: Fresh and floral, this Geisha Washed from Finca Lerida expresses all the finesse of Panama’s high altitudes. Lemongrass opens the sip with a lively note, followed by the delicate aromas of elderflower and the subtle sweetness of honeydew melon . A clean, fragrant cup with remarkable aromatic clarity.

items.title: Panama Finca Lerida • honey
items.desc: At Finca Lerida , the Geisha processed using the Honey method reveals a sweet character full of nuance. Grown at 1,700 meters in Alto Quiel, Panama , it has an aromatic profile in which freshness and sweetness alternate naturally. The first sip brings lively notes of blood orange , followed by the fruity delicacy of white peach . Honey completes the profile with a soft, lingering sweetness, accompanying the finish and enhancing the cup’s complexity. An expressive, balanced Geisha that surprises with every sip.

items.title: Indonesia - Asman Gayo
items.desc:
Asman Gayo coffee comes from the Aceh region in northern Sumatra, where the plants thrive at elevations between 1,300 and 1,650 meters. A natural process enhances aromatic clarity without sacrificing this land’s iconic body.
Being named Italy’s Best Roaster 2026 inspired us to seek the perfect roast curve for this complex lot. We worked to balance the intensity of cocoa nibs with a nuanced, fruity sweetness reminiscent of cherry preserves and dried plum.
The result is a cup with a long, spicy finish. It’s the perfect coffee for those seeking a sensory adventure, far from classic profiles, yet

items.title: Colombia Mama Sierra
items.desc:
Mama Sierra is a single origin that captures the elegance of Antioquia’s high-altitude coffees.
In the cup, you’ll find notes of vanilla, wildflower honey, and yellow plum, with a silky body and a lingering finish.
A coffee crafted for those seeking balance and aromatic clarity, ideal both as a pour-over and as an espresso.

items.title: One. Espresso Process Blend
items.desc:
In our new blend, we decided to use just ONE botanical variety, Catuai, from just ONE growing region. We decided to work with a SINGLE producer, Marisabel and Moises Caballero of Finca El Puente.
The difference is that we’re using four different processing methods.
Our blend will in fact consist of a washed coffee, a natural coffee, a semi-anaerobic coffee and an anaerobic coffee . We chose this approach to show you how a country of origin has evolved in creating different flavor profiles.
Four different processes that will collectively create complexity, intensity, acidity and sweetness, maki

items.title: Colombia Las Perlitas
items.desc: Las Perlitas Pink Bourbon is a washed coffee from small-batch producers in Huila, grown at elevations between 1,900 and 2,300 m above sea level. It stands out for its lively acidity, fruity sweetness, and delicate floral notes, offering an elegant and complex cup profile.

items.title: Jump
items.desc:
Jump is our first specialty coffee blend. Perfectly balanced, it features subtle notes of hazelnut and almonds that gently meld with citrus aromas. This combination of flavors creates a surprising and satisfying taste profile that delights both lovers of artisanal coffee seeking freshness and those who appreciate a light touch of nuts.

items.title: Colombia Galeras Decaf
items.desc:
Decaffeinated single-origin coffee grown on the slopes of the Galeras volcano, in the Nariño region of Colombia. Produced by small local farmers, this coffee combines the quality of the Caturra, Castillo, and Colombia varieties, offering an authentic taste without caffeine.
Notes of caramel, milk chocolate, apple, and lemon, with a perfect balance of sweetness and acidity.

items.title: Oscar Hernandez Typica
items.desc:
Oscar Hernandez, an innovative entrepreneur and part of a new generation of ambitious farmers, will amaze you not only with his extraordinary coffees, but also with his use of advanced technologies and biotechnology in cultivating Los Nogales coffees.
Oscar’s dedication to research and innovation is evident at every stage, from processing and harvesting to drying and transporting the crops. These scientific advances translate into a remarkable improvement in the cup, offering you a unique and extraordinary coffee experience.

items.title: Honduras Finca El Puente Catuai Washed
items.desc: This coffee, produced using the washed process, offers a unique tasting experience defined by balanced sweetness and distinctive tasting notes. Chocolate adds depth and warmth, while hints of green apple bring vibrant freshness and a slight acidity that perfectly balances the overall profile. Subtle cookie notes further enrich the tasting experience.

items.title: MammaMia
items.desc:
MammaMia, our extraordinary specialty coffee blend. This unique blend was created with passion using coffee from four fascinating origins: Peru, Costa Rica, Ethiopia, and Honduras.
MammiaMia is a sensory experience that delights the senses with notes of chocolate and nuts.
Each carefully selected origin contributes uniquely to the creation of MammiaMia.
